title: LLM Powered Cooking: Cook anything, get reviewed by customers, and hopefully make profit.
author: VirtualJamesHarrison
selftext:
You start with 68 ingredients and 20 tools to be unlocked. Cook them in infinite possible ways. Then plate your dish to see the final product, get reviewed by customers, and make a profit if they like it.

Play now for free at [https://infinite-kitchen.com/](https://infinite-kitchen.com/)

My first creation that made money: A snowball lmfao. This is addictive! It feels like an old armorgames game from 2006 i would waste hundreds of hours on, but with 10x the production value. Might i ask how you're handling the AI for this game? hopefully it's not costing you a lot.

replies.author: VirtualJamesHarrison

replies.author: VirtualJamesHarrison
replies.body:
Cost of the AI is pretty much nothing.   
The logic is handled by gemini, caching and some smart game design.    
Images was an issue at first but using the new flux models makes it much more affordable and fast!
